carmen: Quick thread—drafting internal RN for Wed 21:00 PT cutover. Need blurb, pin, embargo, rollback. Model: rdlw-v2.3 (hosted), fallback rdlw-v2.2.
ben: Can we canary 10%? 5% too slow.
carmen: 10% for 30m, then 50% for 15m, then full. Ops asks 45m canary window.
louise: Draft blurb: "Deploy rdlw-v2.3—improved latency & cost. Canary 10% → 50% → full. Pin hosted to rdlw-v2.3; fallback v2.2. Escalate regressions to #eng-oncall." Edit as needed.
ed: Add rollback criteria: error-rate >2% OR p95 latency +30% sustained 10m. Add quick rollback steps.
ben: Paste deploy commands for RN.
deploy-bot: Schedule release 1778213344 — canary 2025-04-02T04:00Z (10%) 30m; ramp 50% 15m; full on success. Commands: `/deploy start release/1778213344 --canary 10 --stagger 30m`, `/deploy pin model rdlw-v2.3 --env hosted`, `/deploy rollback release/1778213344 --to model rdlw-v2.2`.
carmen: Louise, fold commands, criteria, ops checklist into RN. Embargo internal until M-45m then public. Pin RN at 18:00; final signoff 17:45.
louise: Will post final RN 17:30 PT. ed: I'll add one-click rollback playbook link once ready.
